series.name: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — warning codes
series.notes: Warnings, NOT errors: the charger keeps running but has reduced output or paused charging as a protection measure. Same VictronConnect/GX display path and same numeric namespace as the Orion XS error series. Must be kept separate so the app does not tell a customer to stop a system that is only warning.

title.ur: Battery garam hai - output kam kar diya

meaning.en: Output voltage is reduced to the nominal 12 V to prevent battery damage. Auto-resets when the battery cools.
meaning.ur: Battery bachane ke liye output voltage nominal 12 V par kam kar di gayi hai. Battery thande hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Battery genuinely above its safe charging temperature
causes.ur: Battery apni safe charging temperature se upar hai

causes.en: No external temperature sensor fitted, and a hot charger is read as a hot battery
causes.ur: Bahar ka temperature sensor nahi laga, aur garam charger ko garam battery samajh liya gaya

solutions.en: Measure real battery temperature with a probe at the cell terminals.
solutions.ur: Cell terminals par probe se asal battery temperature nikaalein.

solutions.en: Improve airflow around the battery bank; do not place it in a hot enclosed space.
solutions.ur: Battery bank ke aar paas hawa ka raasta behtar karein; use band garm jagah na rakhein.

solutions.en: Fit an external battery temperature sensor so the charger measures the battery, not itself.
solutions.ur: Bahar ka battery temperature sensor lagayein taake charger battery temperature nikaale, apni nahi.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

title.ur: Battery thandi hai - charging ruk gayi

meaning.en: Charging is stopped because the battery is too cold. Victron stress this is a protection feature, not necessarily a fault - lithium batteries are damaged by charging when cold.
meaning.ur: Battery thandi hone ki wajah se charging band hai. Victron zor deta hai ke ye protection hai, fault nahi - lithium batteries thand mein charge hone se nuqsaan hoti hain.

causes.en: LiFePO4 bank below its low charge temperature, common in cold winter nights in Pakistan
causes.ur: LiFePO4 bank apni low charge temperature se neeche, jiski Pakistan mein thande sardi raaton mein aam baat hai

causes.en: No battery heater fitted on a cold night
causes.ur: Thande raat mein koi battery heater nahi laga

solutions.en: Confirm the reading with a probe thermometer before assuming a fault.
solutions.ur: Fault samajhne se pehle probe thermometer se reading confirm karein.

solutions.en: Fit a lithium battery heater if charging in cold weather is a regular requirement.
solutions.ur: Agar thande mausam mein charging aam baat hai to lithium battery heater lagayein.

solutions.en: Only if you are sure this protection is unwanted, ask the installer to adjust the setting.
solutions.ur: Sirf tabhi ke aap ko yakeen ho ke ye protection nahi chahiye, installer se setting badalwayein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

aliases: Current derate due to controller high temperature

title.ur: Charger garam hai - current kam kar diya

meaning.en: The charger has reduced its output current to control its own internal temperature. Auto-resets when it cools down.
meaning.ur: Charger ne apni internal temperature control karne ke liye output current kam kar diya hai. Thanda hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high around the charger
causes.ur: Charger ke aar paas ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Charger not mounted with clearance for cooling
causes.ur: Charger cooling ke liye jagah chhod kar nahi laga

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature at the charger location.
solutions.ur: Charger ki jagah par ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Mount with clearance so air can flow; keep it off the floor and out of direct sun.
solutions.ur: Hawa ke liye jagah chhod kar lagaayein; floor par ya dhoop se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Dust off the heatsink fins with dry compressed air.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ke fins ko dry compressed air se dhool saaf karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

meaning.en: An over-current condition is detected on the battery side, but the unit classifies it as a warning. Auto-resets.
meaning.ur: Battery side par over-current ki shart detect hui hai, magar unit isay warning ke tor par rakhta hai. Khud reset hota hai.

causes.en: Short circuit or very low load resistance on the battery output
causes.ur: Battery output par short circuit ya bohat kam load resistance

causes.en: Bank connected through a welding or chattering contactor
causes.ur: Bank aik welding ya chattering contactor se jury hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the battery output cable and contactor for continuity.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir battery output cable aur contactor ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources, wait 3 minutes, then power up again.
solutions.ur: Tamam power sources disconnect karein, 3 minute intezaar karein, phir on karein.

solutions.en: If it does not auto-reset, the charge controller is probably faulty.
solutions.ur: Agar khud resolve na ho to charge controller kharab hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings
